coordinates.locator: centroid of the SPS access building BA4 (CERN building 871, OSM way 68885471); building number to acronym from MapCERN
coordinates.note: Surface building serving the underground hall; the hall itself sits below at an offset no fetched source publishes, hence the precision.

name: SPS Long Straight Section 4 (UA2)
notes: Coordinates are the CERN Meyrin main-site geocoder point (site:cern-meyrin), reused as the best available anchor; precision_m 3000 is chosen to cover the ~7 km SPS ring, not a survey of the specific hall.

Coordinate kind is 'campus' rather than 'detector'/'underground_lab' because the only coordinate source available in this session is an OpenStreetMap/Nominatim geocoder lookup, and A17 restricts geocoder-backed coordinates to campus/headquarters kind (the validator's GEOCODER_COORDINATE_KINDS). This point should be read as 'the general CERN-site area this marker names', not a surveyed detector-cavern location. Because of this, detector:ua2 does not carry a structured placements[] row against this site (it would require kind 'detector'/'underground_lab', which in turn requires a non-geocoder source we do not have); the experiment-to-place relationship is instead recorded only as prose in this file and via collaboration.host_site_id, per A22/A17 rather than by fabricating a stronger source.

summary.plain: The underground hall on CERN's Super Proton Synchrotron ring where the UA2 detector sat to catch head-on collisions between protons and antiprotons.
summary.technical: One of the SPS's experimental insertion points, conventionally identified as Long Straight Section 4, where UA2 was installed around the beam pipe for the 1981-1990 SppS collider programme.
